name: ci-health
description: Audit and optimize overloaded CI with reproducible baselines, false-positive checks, and post-change validation.

interface.longDescription: Investigate CI demand, queueing, execution, selection, and unreliable checks. Establish reproducible timing and cost baselines, distinguish suspected waste from confirmed bottlenecks, and validate improvements while preserving required evidence. Includes optional read-only GitHub Actions measurement helpers.
defaultPrompt: Use $ci-health to investigate our overloaded CI and establish a baseline.
